name: Geraldine Ferraro

offices.t: United States Ambassador to the United Nations Human Rights Council

summary: Geraldine Anne Ferraro (August 26, 1935 – March 26, 2011) was an American politician, attorney, and diplomat who served as a member of the United States House of Representatives from 1979 to 1985, representing New York's 9th congressional district. A member of the Democratic Party, she was the party's vice presidential nominee in the 1984 presidential election, running alongside presidential nominee and former Vice President Walter Mondale; this made her the first female vice-presidential nominee representing a major American political party. Ferraro was also a journalist, author, and businesswoman.
